entities.summary: Idelphonse Favé, born on February 28, 1812 in Dreux (Eure-et-Loir) and died on March 14, 1894 (aged 81–82) in the 7th arrondissement of Paris, was a French brigadier general, military writer, and member of the French Academy of Sciences.
